pilot_questions.purpose: question-ID exclusion only; no pilot metrics or results are read

id_definitions.question_id: mhq_ + first 16 hex characters of SHA-256(exact UTF-8 source query)
id_definitions.document_id: mhd_ + first 16 hex characters of SHA-256(exact UTF-8 source URL)

selection.seed_use: SHA-256 stable tie-breaking only; no PRNG state
selection.question_order: source type order, then ascending source index
selection.document_order: gold corpus source index, then hard-negative corpus source index
selection.gold_rule: union of every exact evidence URL for every selected answerable question; never size-pruned

hard_negative_method.ranker: local deterministic BM25(k1=1.5,b=0.75) over source title + unchanged body
hard_negative_method.selection: seeded greedy facility location over normalized BM25 coverage
leakage_checks: does not contain every exact evidence fact
does not contain normalized exact non-generic full answer

hash_definitions.question_hashes: SHA-256 of exact decoded source query encoded as UTF-8
hash_definitions.document_hashes: SHA-256 of exact decoded source body encoded as UTF-8
hash_definitions.source_record_hashes: SHA-256 of compact UTF-8 JSON serialization preserving source key order and nulls
hash_definitions.record_line_sha256: SHA-256 of exact compact JSONL record bytes excluding the LF terminator
hash_definitions.output_file_sha256: SHA-256 of exact file bytes including final LF

hard_negatives_exclude_question_gold_com.detail: per linked question/document pair; normalized exact lexical checks
